title: situation.s13_buell_east_tennessee.title

gate.none: Proposed for review: this paper concerns military command, administration or finance; it contains no policy toward a protected population, security order or atrocity consequence.

citations.at: I-16 part II pp. 637–638; Buell’s suggestions and Halleck’s reply printed 23 October, footnoted “true date appears to have been October 22, 12.20 p. m.” Earliest is the conservative printed date.
